items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 17 August 2026 at 4:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic, various fronts affecting the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, soon increasing 4 or 5. Veering west overnight, and occasionally increasing 6 in places until mid-morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, largely clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in places.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West, backing southwest, 3 to 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Rain or showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
